name: tmdb
description: The Movie Database (TMDB) integration — search movies, TV shows, and people; get movie/TV details, seasons, trending titles, discover by genre/year/rating, streaming watch providers (JustWatch data), and recommendations. Authenticates with either a TMDB v3 API key or a v4 API Read Access Token (the skill detects which you pasted). This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB; TMDB's API is free for non-commercial use only. Watch provider data is provided by JustWatch.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: The Movie Database — movie and TV metadata, trending, and watch providers

fields.label: API Key or Read Access Token
fields.helpText: Either works: paste your TMDB v3 API Key (32-character hex) OR your v4 API Read Access Token (long JWT starting with 'eyJ'). Both are shown on the same TMDB API settings page.

fields.label: Region
fields.helpText: Default region for watch providers, certifications, and discover filters (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, default US).

tools.name: tmdb.search_media
tools.description: Search TMDB for movies, TV shows, and people in one query (multi search). Returns trimmed results with id, media_type, title/name, release date, and overview.

query.description: Search text, e.g. a movie title, show name, or person

tools.name: tmdb.get_movie_details
tools.description: Get details for a movie by TMDB id: genres, runtime, overview, rating, certification (for your region), directors, top cast, and keywords.

tools.name: tmdb.get_tv_details
tools.description: Get details for a TV show by TMDB id (seasons, episodes, networks, creators). Pass a season number to get that season's episode list instead.

season.description: Optional season number — returns that season's episodes (0 = specials)

tools.name: tmdb.discover_titles
tools.description: Discover movies or TV shows by filters: genres, year, minimum rating, watch providers (with region), and sort order.

mediaType.description: What to discover: movie or tv (default movie)

withGenres.description: Comma-separated TMDB genre ids, e.g. '878,53' (AND) or pipe for OR

year.description: Release year (primary_release_year for movies, first_air_date_year for TV)

withWatchProviders.description: Pipe-separated watch provider ids, e.g. '8|9' (Netflix|Prime). Uses watchRegion.

watchRegion.description: Region for the watch-provider filter (ISO 3166-1; defaults to the connection's region field)

sortBy.description: Sort order, e.g. popularity.desc, vote_average.desc, primary_release_date.desc

tools.name: tmdb.get_trending
tools.description: Get trending movies, TV shows, or both for today or this week.

tools.name: tmdb.get_watch_providers
tools.description: Get where to stream, rent, or buy a movie or TV show in a region. Watch provider data is provided by JustWatch and the output includes the required JustWatch attribution.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 region to look up (defaults to the connection's region field, then US)

tools.name: tmdb.get_recommendations
tools.description: Get TMDB's recommended titles similar to a given movie or TV show.

id.description: TMDB movie or TV id to base recommendations on
